امتثلتن (form VIII)
# اِمْتَثَلْتُنَّ (imtaṯaltunna) /im.ta.θal.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of اِمْتَثَلَ (imtaṯala)
# اُمْتُثِلْتُنَّ (umtuṯiltunna) /um.tu.θil.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past passive of اِمْتَثَلَ (imtaṯala)
